zh.title: 首次运行时查看更新内容
zh.description: 新版首次加载时展示更新摘要，关闭后不再重复提示；摘要随插件提供，离线也能阅读。

zh.title: 随时重看更新说明
zh.description: 在 System One 插件设置页点击“更新内容”重新查看摘要，或打开完整发布说明。

en.title: See what's new on first run
en.description: The first load of a new release shows a one-time update summary. The summary ships with the plugin and is available offline.

en.title: Revisit release notes at any time
en.description: Select Release notes in the System One plugin settings to read the summary again or open the full release notes.
